baseIncrement.description: Quantity increment: The quantity for an order must be a positive integer multiple of this increment. Here, the size refers to the quantity of the base currency for the order. For example, if the baseIncrement is 0.001, the order quantity can be 1.001 but not 1.0001.

quoteIncrement.description: Quantity increment: The quantity for an order must be a positive integer multiple of this increment. Here, the size refers to the quantity of the quote currency for the order. For example, if the quoteIncrement is 0.001, the order funds can be 1.001 but not 1.0001.

priceIncrement.description: Price increment: The price of an order must be a positive integer multiple of this increment. For example, if the priceIncrement is 0.01, the order price can be 3000.01 but not 3000.001.
